required_scenarios.requirement: Generated IPEG client ID is recognized by the shared predicate
required_scenarios.expected: venue_client_order_id output is_bot_client_order_id=True

required_scenarios.requirement: Generated IPEG open order is counted and cancelled
required_scenarios.expected: cancel_all_live cancels exact generator output and verifies zero open orders

required_scenarios.requirement: External lookalike ID is not misclassified
required_scenarios.expected: invalid namespace/checksum/format is rejected

required_scenarios.requirement: Supervisor restarts from PREPARED
required_scenarios.expected: no duplicate submit; recovery reaches FLAT or QUARANTINED

required_scenarios.requirement: Supervisor restarts after only one leg may have reached exchange
required_scenarios.expected: exchange reconciliation precedes any new request

required_scenarios.requirement: Supervisor restarts from HEDGED
required_scenarios.expected: automatically closes and verifies stable FLAT without owner entry gate

required_scenarios.requirement: Supervisor restarts from CLOSING/RECOVERING
required_scenarios.expected: continues exact durable action and never creates a new pair action

required_scenarios.requirement: Only one Telegram poller exists
required_scenarios.expected: shadow, canary and recovery share one control-plane instance

required_scenarios.requirement: Old release observations cannot qualify new SHA
required_scenarios.expected: mixed release SHA is rejected

required_scenarios.requirement: Config or image change starts a new epoch
required_scenarios.expected: previous 24h duration and counters are not reused

required_scenarios.requirement: Every qualification observation has exact epoch FK
required_scenarios.expected: orphan/missing/mixed epoch observation makes qualification fail

required_scenarios.requirement: Unknown-symbol raw open order fails closed
required_scenarios.expected: UNKNOWN_ACTIVE_RECORD; entry and FLAT denied

required_scenarios.requirement: Malformed non-zero raw position fails closed
required_scenarios.expected: UNKNOWN_ACTIVE_RECORD; entry and FLAT denied

required_scenarios.requirement: Raw/normalized active counts must match
required_scenarios.expected: count mismatch makes private snapshot incomplete

required_scenarios.requirement: Wrong venue/symbol/side event is rejected
required_scenarios.expected: action quarantined and immutable leg unchanged

required_scenarios.requirement: Fill and terminal status cannot regress
required_scenarios.expected: out-of-order regression is ignored/quarantined with audit evidence

required_scenarios.requirement: One client ID cannot map to two exchange order IDs
required_scenarios.expected: identity conflict quarantines action

required_scenarios.requirement: Journal-balanced but exchange-mismatched positions are not HEDGED
required_scenarios.expected: coordinator enters recovery/quarantine

required_scenarios.requirement: Emergency flatten works without qualification file
required_scenarios.expected: actual exposure is journaled and reduced; no entry authorization required

required_scenarios.requirement: Emergency flatten uses actual position symbol
required_scenarios.expected: non-route symbol is closed using its own instrument metadata

required_scenarios.requirement: Dedicated-subaccount kill handles every active order
required_scenarios.expected: unknown/non-IPEG active order prevents success or is cancelled by explicit account-wide policy

required_scenarios.requirement: Late fill after first empty snapshot is detected
required_scenarios.expected: first apparent FLAT never returns success

required_scenarios.requirement: Stable flat barrier requires consecutive snapshots and quiet period
required_scenarios.expected: success only after configured stable reconciliation barrier

required_scenarios.requirement: Private state timeout during flat verification quarantines
required_scenarios.expected: never returns success on incomplete state

required_scenarios.requirement: Emergency venue incompatible amount step/minimum blocks entry
required_scenarios.expected: canary denied before main legs

required_scenarios.requirement: Emergency venue depth and private fee enter stress risk
required_scenarios.expected: projected stress changes with actual third-venue fee/depth

required_scenarios.requirement: Unhedgeable rounded residual blocks entry
required_scenarios.expected: all possible canary residual quantities are proven recoverable or entry denied

required_scenarios.requirement: Required scenario manifest is exact
required_scenarios.expected: removing/deselecting one scenario makes proof fail

required_scenarios.requirement: Proof is exact-head/source/config/image bound
required_scenarios.expected: any identity mismatch makes proof fail

required_scenarios.requirement: No production submit transport is reachable in CI
required_scenarios.expected: production_submit_calls=0 and network boundary assertion passes
